title: Customers Whose Most Recent Order Was Cancelled
description:
For every customer, look at their single most recent order (by `order_date`). Report the `name` of every customer whose most recent order has status `cancelled`.

Name the column `name`. Return the result in any order.
solutionSql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date = (
  SELECT MAX(o2.order_date) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id
)
AND o.status = 'cancelled';
hint: The correlated scalar subquery finds each customer's own latest date — compare the joined order's date against that, not against the whole table's max.
outputExplanation: Bo's only order was cancelled, making it both his first and most recent cancelled order. Ada's and Cy's most recent orders are completed and pending respectively.
